events.name: China NBS Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Official gauge of factory output, new orders and employment in China; a reading below 50 signals contraction.

events.name: Germany CPI (Y-o-Y, Prelim)
events.description: Preliminary annual change in German consumer prices, a leading signal for the Eurozone-wide inflation reading.

events.name: Eurozone CPI (Y-o-Y, Flash)
events.description: Preliminary estimate of Eurozone consumer price inflation, a key input for upcoming European Central Bank policy decisions.

events.name: US ISM Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Survey of US factory purchasing managers on output, orders and employment, gauging manufacturing sector health.

events.name: US ADP Employment Change
events.description: Monthly change in US private-sector payrolls, an early signal ahead of Friday's official jobs report.

events.name: US Fed Beige Book
events.description: Federal Reserve's qualitative summary of regional economic conditions, informing the upcoming FOMC interest-rate decision.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment benefit filings, a timely gauge of labour market health.

events.name: UK Services PMI (Final)
events.description: Tracks activity in the UK's dominant services sector via new business, output and employment among purchasing managers.

events.name: US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP)
events.description: Monthly change in US non-farm employment, the most closely watched indicator of US labour market strength.

events.name: US Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of the US labour force that is unemployed and actively seeking work, a core gauge of labour slack.
